flow_ref: User story (not in any OCMS flow deck)
code_summary: ocmsadminui src/App.tsx, src/i18n/en/translation.json, src/utils/validation/Format/ValidFile.ts, src/utils/models/Icourtcase.d.ts, src/pages/NoticeSearch/{form/NoticeSearchAllForm.tsx,hook/useSearch.ts,hook/useSearchParams.tsx,list/NoticeSearchAllList.tsx}, src/pages/Notice/{context/NoticeContext.tsx,form/History.tsx}, src/pages/Report/{index.tsx,action/ActionReport.tsx}, src/utils/config/env.ts. ocmsadminapi crud/ocmsizdb/OcmsCourtCase/OcmsCourtCase.java (3 columns) and workflows/cas_integration/CasIntegrationController (inbound CAS, not credited). ocmsadminprivateapi, ocmseserviceapi, ocmseserviceui, thirdpartyapi: no court document upload code
note: The court document upload epic has no code in the six repos. Only leftovers exist in ocmsadminui: the label 'Court Upload Documents' in translation.json:105-106, the file rule court_upload_doc (10 MB, Document) in ValidFile.ts:182-185 which no component uses, the Icourtcase type (doc_type, file_name, b_lob, send_to_sc_flag) in Icourtcase.d.ts:41-49 with no upload user in the UI, and an empty '{/* COURT */}' block in App.tsx:313. The OcmsCourtCase entity in ocmsadminapi has only 3 columns (notice_no, court_payment_due_date, reason; OcmsCourtCase.java:20-31) and is used by the inbound CAS endpoints (CasIntegrationController), not for document upload; the CAS endpoints are not credited because no step of this story matches them. State Courts SFTP/batch is not in the six repos (earlier court epic finding). The status 'Demo paid (50% of 75%)' is a sheet claim; the code does not support it. The story status is blank in the sheet (requirement not given); traced normally. The Report menu has four court entries (Court Application Vault, Court Application Submit, Court Summon, Court Rejected) but all have no page (empty path) and the courtcasesummary resource is commented out; they are also application/summon reports, not uploaded-document reports. Ticket OCMS-DF-2026-194 (Open) only mentions 'new court reports' and is not proof that code exists.
recommendation: Do not claim as done. Only placeholder court report menu entries (empty path) exist; no report generator for uploaded documents exists.

steps.step: OCMS generates a summary report for the uploaded court documents
steps.detail: The Report menu has four court entries in Report/index.tsx:61-76, all with path "" (no page), and the resource in ActionReport.tsx:35-64 is commented out (courtcasesummary endpoint). These are court application/summon reports, not uploaded-document reports, and there is no generator in ocmsadminapi or ocmsadminprivateapi. Ticket OCMS-DF-2026-194 mentions 'new court reports' coming (still Open); not proof of code.

steps.step: The report covers all court case types used for upload
steps.detail: There is no report per court case type for upload. The court entries in ActionReport.tsx:35-64 are only labels with commented-out type filters (VE/SH, CA/CAE, S/SE, R/RE); there is no data or query in the backend (no courtcasesummary endpoint in the six repos).

steps.step: The report includes errors, if any, for the uploaded documents
steps.detail: No result or error of court document uploads is recorded because the upload does not exist (see OCMS29.3). The error views that exist in the repo (for example UploadErrorList for notice number upload in NoticeSearch/page/upload/UploadErrorList.tsx) serve other functions and are not credited.
